compounddef.title: XilAsu ML-DSA API Example Generic Usage

detaileddescription.para: This example illustrates the usage of the ASU ML-DSA (FIPS 204) client APIs. It signs a test message with a fixed ML-DSA-44 private key (pure ML-DSA, hedged, no context) and verifies the resulting signature against the matching public key. Signing and verification take the key from the caller, so the example supplies a known pair: ML-DSA key generation is a key manager operation and is shown in the key manager example. Both keys below are taken verbatim from the NIST ACVP server test data (github.com/usnistgov/ACVP-Server, gen-val/json-files, ML-DSA-sigGen-FIPS204/internalProjection.json), tgId 1 tcId 7. That is the same ACVP test case the firmware CAST in xasufw_kat.c uses, so the two agree byte for byte.
